cohort: 88 mothers (44 with gestational diabetes and 44 without) recruited from obstetric departments at Al-Shifa Maternity Hospital in Gaza and Mubarak Maternity Hospital in Khan Yunis.
finding: Gestational diabetes mellitus was significantly associated with lower neonatal blood glucose, serum albumin, and iron status, as well as an increased risk of cesarean section delivery and neonatal hypoglycemia.
birth_weight: Median neonatal birth weight was measured
